name: Handout 10: The Mark of Mars
player_description:
THE MARK OF MARS
This character has stood before a god of war and lived.

For the remainder of their days:
- Advantage on Intimidation checks. Other soldiers see something in them they cannot name.
- Once per long rest: ask the DM 'What does Mars want from this situation?' and receive an honest answer.

In exchange: Mars may call on them. Once. At his choosing.
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 5, at the very end, after the final confrontation. Give one card to EACH player.
HOW: Simple calling card. Edge-highlight with red ink. Keep a duplicate so players can tuck it into character folios.
WHAT IT REVEALS: The campaign's permanent mechanical legacy. The 'once per long rest' divine question is genuinely answered honestly in-character — Mars does not lie, he simply does not volunteer more than asked. 'Mars may call on them once' is the hook for a future campaign or one-shot. Do not specify what the call will be. Let it sit.
